review_backend: Codex agent read-only analysis; no external reviewer MCP was available in this environment

integrity.evaluation_scope: observer-replay mechanism sensitivity, not validated ownership detector

limitations: Descriptive AUROC/AUPRC uses official token annotations only after the completed population; it is not an ownership, routing, or causal-certificate metric.
Source-balanced conditional means are descriptive and use only sources carrying the respective normal/error class; error-source counts can be much lower than normal-source counts.
No post-first-error metric subset was emitted by the evaluator. The post-first counts are arithmetic complements only and must not be read as post-first AUROC or conditional-mean results.
The observer has a substantial saved-token mismatch rate, so these are replay-observer signals rather than generator-native explanations.
No confidence intervals or bootstrap replicates were run (the frozen evaluator records bootstrap=0).
No external experiment-audit reviewer MCP was callable in this environment; this is an independent read-only agent audit, not a cross-model verdict.
